instruction: Save the document as a plain text file with the same name to the Documents folder

metadata.explanation: Task requires saving the document as a text file to the Documents folder. The evaluator checks if the text file has at least 10 lines (document has substantial content with tables and paragraphs that should produce many lines when exported to text).

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly checks file location (/home/user/Documents/View_Person_Organizational_Summary.txt) matching instruction requirements (Documents folder, same name, .txt extension)
Getter logic correctly retrieves file from VM and handles missing files by returning None

Line count threshold (min_lines=10) is reasonable for verifying substantial content was exported
